feedback: deterministic, grounding, and model story critics accept

findings.detail: name questions must request the full name explicitly
opening paragraph must read as narration, not an ID table
Deterministic grounding reports no missing required fact realizations, no duplicate scene assignments, and no unknown scene obligations.
The evidence is presented as coherent prose paragraphs rather than as tables, bullet ledgers, or a personnel-index wall.
No person is assigned contradictory statuses for the same stream; each of the five participants has a consistent six-stream record.
The story states the governing criterion and accepted tally but does not name the qualifying person; it explicitly says the surviving page named no winner.
The main, intermediate, counterfactual, and scalar questions are unambiguous under the disclosed status scale and iterative tally procedure.
